content.title: Where to watch Phillies vs. Cubs series opener tonight on free streams, TV
content.text: The Philadelphia Phillies are back at Citizens Bank Park on Monday for the opener of a three-game series with the Chicago Cubs. The game is scheduled to start at 6:40 p.m. ET with TV coverage on FS1 and streaming on-demand.How to watch Phillies vs. Cubs on TV and stream without cable:When:Monday, April 13 at 6:40 p.m. ETWhere:Citizens Bank Park, Philadelphia, Pa.TV channel: FS1Streaming on: FuboTV (free trial) | DirecTV (free trial) | SlingTV (low intro rate)Phillies vs. Cubs: The matchupThe Phillies go into Monday’s series opener as solid betting favorites (-186) in a matchup of playoff contenders with identical 7-8 records through the first 15 games of the season. Philadelphia enters having lost four of its past five games, including two of three in a home series with the Arizona Diamondbacks that wrapped on Sunday with a 4-3 win for the visiting Dbacks. The Cubs avoided a home sweep by the Pittsburgh Pirates with a walkoff, 7-6 win in Sunday’s finale.See also: MLB coverage on PennLiveThe Phillies are expected to start left-hander Cristopher Sanchez, who is 1-1 with a 1.65 ERA and 1.35 WHIP in three starts this season after a breakout 2025 campaign where he went 13-5 with a 2.50 ERA. The Cubs will give the ball to righty Javier Assad, who won his only start of the season last Tuesday by allowing one hit over 5.2 scoreless innings as the Cubs beat the Tampa Bay Rays (9-2) on the road.Phillies vs. Cubs: Know your live streamsFuboTV (free trial): FuboTV offers the most extensive package of live sports with rates competitive with DirecTV.
